scope_note: Twelve additional OS2 44 kHz effect algorithms; these are not additional numbered ROM effect slots.
grouped_expert_instances: FDBK T, TIME L, TIME R, GAIN L, and GAIN R each describe four tap controls when listed.

variation_and_modulation.variation_behavior: Each variation is individually editable and acts as an effect edit buffer.
variation_and_modulation.manual_applicability: Section 5 says most effects support these controls; applicability for each OS2 algorithm requires live OS confirmation.
variation_and_modulation.restriction: A parameter assigned as a modulation destination cannot be edited directly until modulation is disabled; disabling modulation restores its saved value.

range_evidence: ASR-10 Musician's Manual Appendix, alphabetized effect parameter reference, PDF pp. 377-382
